meta.title: Two bids: award all 10 units to the L1 vendor (B); approver rejects
gaps: The prepared state has only one bid, so the required two-vendor comparison with Vendor B as the L1 vendor cannot be created or verified.
The Awarded Vendors counter cannot be verified as 1/2 because only one vendor is present in the prepared state.
The allocation cannot be verified as Vendor B receiving 10 units at 90 for a total of 900.
Filling required proposal fields and submitting the proposal is not expressible on the proposal screen with the available catalog steps.
Signing in as the approver and rejecting the proposal with a remark is not expressible because no approver rejection step or alternate approver login is available.
Verifying that no purchase order is created and that the buyer can start awarding again from Master QCS is not expressible.

steps.note: Open the prepared closed bidding event directly on Master QCS.
Open the awarding page for the available bid.
Allocate the available line item to the available vendor.
Verify that the available single line item and vendor are allocated.
Open the proposal page from the awarding screen.
Verify that proposal creation reached the proposal screen.
